name: Blind
details:
Severely darkens the surrounding area. This flaw makes you immune to Flame Blind and Gaze, and allows you to obtain Blindseer without a Blindfold. Also turns your eyes white.

Gremors have a glow that allows them to see slightly further while blind.

name: Fugitive
description: Your past isn't so spotless. All Factions hate you.
details: You start with much lower reputation for all factions.

name: Glutton
description: Your hunger and thirst is depleted faster.
details: Increases the rate that your stomach and thirst bars passively deplete. This does not affect non-passive stomach or thirst loss (e.g. Enchantments).

name: Haemophilia
details: Increases blood **loss** from taking damage. Blood **drain** effects are unaffected.

name: Manic
description: All insanity gained from attacks is heavily amplified.
details: Increases sanity lost from sanity-draining attacks.

name: Simple
description: You learn things at a slower rate than others.
details: Requires exponentially more EXP curve to Power up, and reduce all Knowledge gain by 25%, rounded to the nearest whole number.

name: Squeamish
description: Having to physically take the life of another makes you lose stomach.
details: Lose a small amount of stomach meter when manually executing others and killing monsters. Alternative execution methods (e.g. drowning, burning, or any autoexexute) will bypass this effect.

name: Vegetarian
description: Eating the flesh of animals has a chance to make you vomit.
details:
Grants a 50% chance to vomit when consuming meat-based food items. The Bloodrend Cantrip does not bypass this limitation.

Mutually exclusive with [Carnivore](/wiki/talent/Carnivore).

Cannot be rolled from the Shrine of Blasphemy.
